== Original post ==

'''Deck Wreckers Turn 1 Deal W'06'''
* '''Author:''' noah "thehooky" franke
* '''Published:''' October 25, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.92
* '''Description:''' deal on the first turn every game at worlds '06.

=== Strategy ===

it did good at worlds '06! and that is after it was posted on line! i should have played this deck for day 2! i would not have lost with it! well unless luck stepped in aginst me!

this deck loss to crubby decks, at worlds for a fun game it lost to DDM becouse of Panic! i battle his lone scrub and becouse of DDeal my guys was power 6, so he played panic fo deploy luke and han EPP for free! so yeah i lost that battle and took 11 over flow!

it also lost to a LS senate deck were each turn he used the objective to take 2 cards from my hand...each time he grabed all my anti battle cards! leaveing all my lone characters definsless to beat downs!! it was just bad luck of the draw! and he stopped the occupation damage turn 2! and he played control combo about 4 times that game and used a political effect that stopped my drains 2 times a turn! played the queen then another senater! it was just insane! but it still only lost by 15.

this deck owns Whap! you would think its a hard mach up! but its realy easy! just drain and occupation damage and go beat him up at his sites if you want too! and you will never have to worry about space in a whap deck..well, keep some protection in hand for your space just incase!

this is the most solid deal deck you can play right now. you can pull Adm Ozzle and Sarg Merril with Endor Shield V. so now all you need is at least 1 more trooper to set up dark deal. and one ship. you have 9, the chance of you drawing a ship in your starting hand is almost 100% but you toss in some of the randem things with playing cards and it possable that you wont get a ship in starting hand, or any other trooper or any cards that help you eavade the other players battles. so far it has not happend very many times.

draw your hand and loss a card from hand to get DD.

then pull your 2 characters with ESV and get your 2 sites with im sorry.

activate at least 3(more if able) and pull CC. if your able to set up turn 1 do it. Imperial supply is a great card. i hear alot of people tell me" you lose 2 cards to activate 4! and 2 more cards with Tactical Support to pull up 3 troopers and another card with CrossFire V? thats 5 cards turn 1!! and they used Toss back V 4 times!! yeah you do. but it helps you win so its a good deal!

you dont want to get carried away with playing Tactical Support and Imperial supply. the card can do too things, it can make you lose the game or make you win the game! becareful with those cards

also only deploy 1 guy to a site and leave them there all game. if the light side deploys a guy use all your tricks to stop the battle. then come down next turn with a big power house of troopers. this deck is hard to play! it takes alot of "Pae-tions", just like reading my poor grammer and spelling.

turn one every game...unless you suck at shuffling?!

Any light deck that gives me force lets me win for free...TRM and WYSV are the only decks that choke me! and would not let me set up on turn 1...unless you draw at least 1 Imperial supply.

at Oregon states i did not play with Shields for more ships.

hear are all the ones that are still playable...the Best and most power full Dark Deal deck was with CRV before the redux, you had 4 effects and started with a Load of activation. also you were able to have CC occupation, dark deal and Search and Destroy in play on the first turn!! but its gone now.....

some people say that it takes luck to play and set up turn 1.....the first deck hear sets up turn 1 every time...in testing it has set up a couple of times on the 2nd turn. in all tournament play it has set up turn 1 and in most testing play as well. the key to setting up so fast is all the doubles and triples of cards you need, makeing it very easy to draw what you need in your opening hand...and grimmtosh has been no problem at all...dispite what people say.

now that these decks are posted i dont beleave they will do well. my self i wont be playing them any more(sob sob) the biggist reason they win is becouse deal is busted and nobody is expecting it to set up this fast with power to back it up, or it takes them tell the 3-4 turn to get into play, thats when they take a loss with a trooper power house!
